DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車が見当たらないとのことですね。最後に停めた状況を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your bicycle is missing, is that right? Please describe the last time you parked it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨夜、自宅の駐輪場に停めました。今朝なくなっていましたが、家族も使うので、盗まれたと決めてよいかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨夜自宅へ停め家族使用の可能性もあると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I parked it at my home's bicycle parking area last night. It was gone this morning, but my family uses it too, so I do not know whether to conclude it was stolen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you parked it at home last night and a family member may have used it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご家族に使用したか確認されていますか。確かめたことと、まだのことを分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you checked whether your family used it? I will ask separately about what you have and have not confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一人には聞いて、使っていないと返事がありました。もう一人とはまだ連絡が取れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一人は未使用で一人は未連絡と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I asked one person, who said they had not used it. I have not yet managed to contact the other person.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the person who did not use it from the person not yet contacted. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 未確認の方がいるのですね。自転車を見分ける特徴は何かありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: So one person is still unconfirmed. Does the bicycle have any identifying features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 銀色の車体で、後ろに大きなかごがあります。かごの底に黄色い留め具を付けています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 銀色の車体と後ろかごの黄色い留め具を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It has a silver frame and a large rear basket. I attached a yellow fastener to the bottom of the basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the silver frame and yellow fastener on the rear basket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 特徴を記録します。昨夜の置き場所を、ほかの車体の位置と分けて説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will record those features. Can you describe last night's parking position separately from the positions of other bicycles?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 屋根のある列の一番端です。今朝は別の自転車がそこにありましたが、誰の物かはわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 屋根付き列の端と別車体があった状況を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: At the very end of the covered row. Another bicycle was there this morning, but I do not know whose it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the end of the covered row and the other bicycle found there. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: わからないことは推測しないでおきましょう。登録の情報を確認できる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us avoid guessing what you do not know. Do you have anything showing the registration information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 購入時の控えを家で探せます。家族の返事と登録情報を確認し、見つかった場合もこちらへ知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族の返事と登録情報を調べ発見時も知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can look for the purchase record at home. I will check my family's reply and the registration details, and tell you if it is found too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check your family's reply and registration details and report it if found. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 現在わかる状況として承りました。確認できた情報が増えたらお伝えください。お帰りの道中もお気を付けて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have noted this as the situation currently known. Please let us know when more information is confirmed. Take care on your way home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 書類をお送りになるのですね。送った後に、気にかかっていることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are sending documents. Is there anything concerning you after they are sent?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 原本なので返してもらいたいです。配達の記録が残る方法なら、書類も戻ってくるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 配達記録のある方法と原本が戻ることの関係を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: They are originals, so I want them returned. If I use a method with a delivery record, will the documents come back too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the relationship between recorded delivery and the return of originals. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 配送の記録と、送付先から原本を返すことは別の確認になります。返却について送付先から案内されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The delivery record and the recipient's return of originals need separate confirmation. Has the recipient provided return instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 返却の案内は読んでいませんでした。記録のある送付方法を選んでも、返してもらえるとは限らないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 送付先の返却案内をまだ読んでいないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I had not read the return instructions. So choosing a recorded shipping method does not necessarily mean they will return them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not yet read the recipient's return instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 送付先へ原本が必要か、返却の方法は何かを先に確認しましょう。ご希望の配送の記録も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: First ask the recipient whether originals are needed and how they return them. I will also ask what delivery records you want.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 届いた状況を調べられるようにしたいです。受け取ったことを示す別の記録が必要かは、送付先にも聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 配達状況を見たい希望と受取記録の要否を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to be able to check the delivery status. I will also ask the recipient whether a separate record proving receipt is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm your wish to see delivery status and whether a receipt record is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な記録がわかれば候補をご案内できます。返送用の準備についても、送付先の指示と合わせて確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once we know the records needed, we can suggest options. Check return-shipping preparations against the recipient's instructions too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 封筒はまだ閉じていません。原本が必要かと返送の準備を聞き、内容をそろえてから持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 原本の要否と返送準備を聞いてから内容をそろえる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not sealed the envelope. I will ask whether originals are needed and how to prepare for their return, then bring everything once ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether originals and return preparations are needed before assembling the contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それから候補の条件や費用を確認しましょう。送る際に受け取る控えは保管しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then let us check the options' conditions and costs. Please keep the receipt you receive when sending.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 原本の要否と返却方法を先に確認し、必要な配達記録に合う送り方を相談します。返却と配送の記録を混同しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返却方法と配達記録を分けて送り方を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will first check whether originals are needed and how they are returned, then discuss a shipping method matching the delivery record required. I will not confuse return with delivery records.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Discuss shipping with return procedures and delivery records kept separate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 送る前に確認できてよかったです。送付先の案内がそろったら封筒と一緒にお持ちください。またのご相談をお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: It is good you checked before sending. Bring the recipient's instructions with the envelope when ready. We look forward to helping you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座の申込みについてですね。記入する前に確かめたい点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about applying for an account. Is there anything to check before filling in the form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 初めて相談します。普段使う名前と、持ってきた身分証の名前の表記が違うので、どちらで書くか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初めての口座相談で普段の名前と身分証の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: This is my first consultation. The name I usually use is written differently from the name on the ID I brought, so I am unsure which to write.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference between your everyday name and ID at your first account consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 資料にある表記を見ながら担当へ確認しましょう。ご自身で略した名前を書く前に、違う部分を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check with the staff while looking at the document's spelling. Before writing an abbreviated name yourself, tell us which parts differ.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 普段は名前の一部を省いていますが、身分証にはすべて書かれています。カタカナの欄も自分で決めてよいかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 省いた名前とカタカナ欄を自分で決めず相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I usually omit part of my name, but my ID shows all of it. I also do not know whether I may decide the katakana field myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Consult rather than decide the shortened name and katakana field yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表記を照合してからご案内します。口座を使う目的についても、担当へ伝えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will guide you after comparing the spellings. Could you also tell the staff why you want to use the account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 毎月の生活費を管理したいです。表記の相談に加えて、私の状況で必要な書類も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 生活費管理の目的で必要な資料も確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to manage monthly living expenses. Besides the name spelling, I want to check which documents my situation requires.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm required documents too, explaining the purpose is managing living expenses. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な確認を担当がご案内します。今日の資料だけで足りるか、原本が必要かも含めて相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff will explain the required checks. Let us also discuss whether today's documents suffice and whether originals are needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は身分証の原本を持っています。ほかの資料は何を用意するか、書き方と分けてメモしてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 身分証の原本を示し書き方と準備物を分けて残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the original ID today. May I note which other documents to prepare separately from how to fill in the form?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present the original ID and record form instructions separately from required preparations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、名前の表記と準備する書類を分けて記録してください。確認前に申込みが受け付けられたとは考えず、担当の案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, record the name spelling and documents to prepare separately. Do not assume your application has been accepted before checking; wait for the staff's guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 省いた名前を先に書かず、資料の表記とカタカナの欄を確認します。生活費管理の目的を伝え、必要書類も別にメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 正式表記と読み方を照合し必要書類を別に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not write the shortened name first; I will check the document's spelling and katakana field. I will explain my living-expense purpose and note required documents separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare official spelling and reading, and check required documents separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記入前の相談として承りました。資料をお手元に置いたまま担当の案内をお待ちください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have received this as a consultation before filling in the form. Keep your documents with you and wait for the staff's guidance. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 果物の価格表示についてですね。どのパックをご覧になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about fruit price labels. Which packs are you looking at?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: こちらの二つです。大きさが違うのに棚の値段が同じなので、一パックの値段なのか気になりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大きさの違う二パックに同じ棚表示がある理由を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: These two. They differ in size but the shelf price is the same, so I wondered whether it was the price per pack.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask why two differently sized packs have the same shelf label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示の単位を見てみましょう。「百グラム当たり」と書かれているか、パックのラベルも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us look at the unit. We will check whether it says “per 100 grams” and check the pack labels too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 百グラム当たりとあります。一パックの値段ではないのですね。買うときの合計はラベルのどこで見られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 百グラム当たりとパックの総額を区別して表示箇所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says per 100 grams. So it is not the price of one pack. Where on the label can I see the total to pay?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish per-100-gram pricing from the pack total and ask where it is displayed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この商品の重量と価格の欄を見比べましょう。棚の表示がどちらの商品を指すかも確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us compare this product's weight and price fields. We will also check which product the shelf label refers to.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 重さと価格の欄がわかりました。もう一つは別の産地なので、同じ棚表示が当てはまるとは限らないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 重量と価格を読み産地が違うことを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I found the weight and price fields. The other one is from a different place, so the same shelf label may not apply to it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Read the weight and price and point out the different origins. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それぞれの商品名と産地を照合します。確認した総額をお伝えしてから、選んでいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will compare each product's name and origin. You can choose after we tell you the confirmed totals.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 予算以内のパックを選びたいです。二つの総額を並べて教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予算で選ぶため二つのパック価格を並べて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to choose a pack within my budget. Could you tell me the two totals side by side?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the two pack prices side by side to choose within your budget. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 両方を確認しましょう。選んだら、お持ちの商品と価格の欄をもう一度合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check both. After choosing, compare the product you are holding with the price field once more.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 重さ当たりの表示と一パックの総額を分けて見ます。商品と産地を確かめて、予算に合うほうを選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 単位と総額と産地を照合し予算に合わせて選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will distinguish the weight-based price from the pack total. I will check the product and origin and choose the one within my budget.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare units, totals and origins, and choose to fit your budget. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認が済むまで少しお待ちください。二つのラベルを照らしてご案内します。お買い物のご相談、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait while we check. We will compare the two labels and explain. Thank you for asking about your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散策の案内をご覧になっていますね。今日はどちらへ行く予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at the walking guide. Where do you plan to go today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 遠くの展望場所まで歩こうと思っていましたが、今日は疲れやすいです。途中で座れる短い案に変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 疲れやすいため展望場所より短い散歩を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I planned to walk to the distant viewpoint, but I tire easily today. I want to change to a short plan with somewhere to sit along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a shorter walk instead of the viewpoint because you tire easily. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 長いコースをそのまま選ばず、入口近くの候補を見ましょう。休める場所を先に確かめたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Rather than keeping the long route, let us look at options near the entrance. Do you want to check resting places first?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、歩いてから休む場所を探すより、先に知りたいです。屋根のある休憩場所も図にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 座れる場所と屋根の記号を図で確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I want to know beforehand instead of looking after walking. Does the map show covered rest areas too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the seating places and roof symbols on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 図の記号を見て確認しましょう。利用できるかや混み具合は現地の表示も確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the map symbols. Please also check the on-site signs for availability and crowding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 休憩場所が使えなかったら、遠い次の場所を目指さず入口へ戻るつもりです。近くで戻れる道を示してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 休憩できなければ遠くへ進まず入口へ戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: If the rest area is unavailable, I plan to return to the entrance instead of heading to the next distant place. Could you show a nearby return route?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: If you cannot rest, return to the entrance instead of going farther. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 入口へ戻る候補を示します。休憩場所まで行く途中でも、疲れたら歩く距離を短くしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will show possible routes to the entrance. Even on the way to the rest area, shorten the distance if you become tired.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は展望場所へは行きません。短い範囲で歩き、入口へ戻ってから迎えの人に連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 展望場所をやめ入口に戻って迎えへ連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not go to the viewpoint today. I will walk within a short area and contact the person picking me up after returning to the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Skip the viewpoint, return to the entrance and contact your pickup person. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 迎えの方には入口の表示を伝えておくとよいでしょう。園内の道の表示を見ながら、戻る場所を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: It would help to tell your pickup person the entrance sign. Check where to return while looking at the signs along the park paths.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口の表示を控え、短い道と休憩場所を確認して歩きます。使えない場合や疲れた場合は、先へ進まず入口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示を確かめ休めない場合や疲れた場合は戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will note the entrance sign, check the short route and resting place, then walk. If it is unavailable or I get tired, I will return to the entrance instead of continuing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the signs and return if you cannot rest or become tired. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今日の調子に合わせた予定ができましたね。休憩も取りながら、ご自分のペースでどうぞ。お迎えの方と無事に会えますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have made a plan matching how you feel today. Take breaks and go at your own pace. I hope you meet your pickup person safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗換通路をお探しですね。大きなケースをお持ちですが、移動について希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking for the transfer passage. You have a large case; do you have any preferences for getting around?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 楽器が入っていて両手がふさがります。乗り換えるホームまで、階段を使わない経路を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 両手がふさがる楽器ケースを持ち階段を使わない乗換経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: It contains an instrument and keeps both hands occupied. I want a route without stairs to the transfer platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a stair-free transfer route while carrying an instrument case that occupies both hands. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習用構内図には、連絡通路へ上がる昇降機の印があります。ただ、階段の経路より少し回り道です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: This practice station map shows a lift going up to the connecting passage. However, it is a slightly longer route than the stairs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 回り道でも昇降機を使いたいです。上がった後で、もう一度下りる場所も図にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 回り道でも昇降機を選び上がった後の下りる印を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to use the lift even with the detour. Does the map also show where I go down again after going up?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the lift despite the detour and check the downward symbol after ascending. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 反対側の印が下りる場所です。上がる所だけ見て進まず、二つの印をつないで経路を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The symbol on the other side is where you go down. Do not follow only the upward point; connect both symbols to check the route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二つの印をつないで見ます。乗換時間が短いので、混んでいたら次の便を考えた方がよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 上下の印をつないで見て短い乗換時間で混雑したら次便を考えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will connect the two symbols. The transfer time is short; if it is crowded, should I consider the next service?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Connect the upward and downward symbols and ask about the next service if crowded during a short transfer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ケースを持って急げるかは判断せず、余裕のある計画にしたいですね。次の便を使う場合の予定は確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Rather than judge whether you can rush with the case, let us allow extra time. Have you checked your plans if using the next service?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会場には早めに着く予定なので、次の便でも間に合うか案内で比べます。無理に階段へ変えるつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 次便の到着を比べ無理に階段経路へ変更しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I planned to arrive early at the venue, so I will compare the guidance to see if the next service is in time. I will not force a change to the stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare the next arrival and say you will not force a switch to the stair route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 経路と便の両方を見直す案ですね。ケースを置く場所も通路をふさがないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: So you will review both route and service. Please also make sure the place you put the case does not block the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通路では立ち止まる場所を選び、昇降機の経路を使います。時間が足りなければ次の便の案内を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通路をふさがず昇降機を使い足りなければ次便の案内を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will choose where to stop in the passage and use the lift route. If time is insufficient, I will check the next service's guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Avoid blocking the passage, use the lift, and check the next service if time is short. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 出発前に現地の表示もご覧ください。それでは、楽器を気をつけてお持ちになって、ご移動ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Check the on-site signs before leaving too. Please carry your instrument carefully as you go.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書についてご相談ですね。申込みの案内か、指定された様式をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice about a certificate. Do you have the application instructions or designated form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 研修の申込みで証明書が必要です。この用紙をもらったので、ここで発行してもらう物だと思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 研修用の証明書を行政窓口で発行すると思って来たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need a certificate to apply for training. I received this form and came thinking it was something you issue here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you came thinking the administrative counter issues the training certificate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習用の様式には、勤務先が記入する欄があります。案内には発行元の指定も書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This practice form has a field for your employer to complete. Do the instructions specify the issuer too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 発行元は所属する会社とあります。証明書なら市役所で取ると思い込んでいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 所属会社が発行元で証明書を市役所の物と思い込んだと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says the issuer is my company. I assumed certificates were obtained at city hall.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your company is the issuer and you assumed certificates were city-hall documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 名称だけでなく、その指定を見て相談先を決めたいですね。会社で誰に頼めるか、わかっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us choose whom to consult using that instruction, not just the name. Do you know whom to ask at work?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 直属の上司には聞けます。用紙にある在籍という言葉がわからないので、その意味も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 上司に相談できるが在籍の意味を確認したいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can ask my direct supervisor. I do not understand the word “enrollment” on the form, so I want to check its meaning too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you can consult your supervisor but want to check what enrollment means. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ここでは、その会社に所属していることを示す言葉として使われています。どの情報を会社が記入するかは、指定を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here it means belonging to that company. Check the requirements for which information the company should fill in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 所属していることを示すのですね。申込者の欄と会社の欄を分けて、上司に見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 所属を示す意味と確認し本人欄と会社欄を分けて上司へ見せると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: So it shows that I belong to the company. I will separate the applicant's field from the company's and show my supervisor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm it means belonging and say you will distinguish your fields from the company's for your supervisor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まだわからない欄は、そのまま質問できるよう印を付けておくとよいでしょう。研修の提出先にも確認できますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: It helps to mark unclear fields so you can ask about them as they are. You can also check with the training application's recipient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は市役所への申請をせず、会社に記入する欄を相談します。会社でもわからない指定は研修の提出先に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 市役所申請をせず会社に記入を相談し不明な指定を研修提出先へ聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not apply at city hall today; I will ask my company about completing its fields. Any requirements the company also does not understand, I will ask the training recipient.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not apply at city hall; consult your company about its fields and ask the training recipient about unclear requirements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、様式と案内をお持ち帰りください。必要な指定を確かめて、申込みの準備が進みますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take the form and instructions home. I hope you can confirm the requirements and progress with your application preparations.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の時期の欄を確認します。今日からと書かれていますが、もう少し説明したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let us check the timing field on the medical questionnaire. You wrote “from today”; is there anything else to explain?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は朝から喉が気になります。ただ、先週にも同じようなことが一度あり、今日からとだけ書いてよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今朝から気になるが先週も一度あり今日からだけでよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My throat has bothered me since this morning. But I had something similar once last week, so I am unsure whether to write only “from today.”
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say it bothers you this morning but happened once last week too, and ask if “from today” alone is sufficient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ずっと続いていたのか、間に気にならない期間があったのかを分けて伺いましょう。先週から毎日でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us distinguish continuous symptoms from an interval without them. Was it every day since last week?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 毎日ではありません。先週気になった日の後は何も感じず、今朝また気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 先週気になった日の後は何も感じず今朝また気づいたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not every day. After the day last week, I felt nothing, then noticed it again this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you felt nothing after that day last week and noticed it again this morning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その経過を言葉で残せますね。この練習用の用紙では、日付が不確かな場合もそう説明します。先週の曜日は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can record that course in words. On this practice form, also explain if the date is uncertain. Do you remember which day last week?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 水曜日だったと思いますが、はっきり覚えていません。確実なのは今朝また気になったことです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先週水曜と思うが不確かで今朝の再発は確実と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I think Wednesday, but I do not remember clearly. What is certain is that it bothered me again this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you think last Wednesday but are unsure, while this morning's recurrence is certain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確かな部分と記憶が曖昧な部分を分けて伝えてください。時期だけでは原因を判断しませんので、担当者にも経過を説明しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Separate what is certain from what you vaguely remember. Timing alone does not establish the cause, so explain the course to the staff too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日からずっとという意味にならないよう、間は気にならなかったと書き足したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 継続と読まれないよう間は気にならなかったと加えたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to add that it did not bother me in between, so it does not read as though it has been continuous from today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to add that it did not bother you in between so it is not read as continuous. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その点を担当者に伝えられるよう記入を手伝います。書いた内容を一度読み上げて確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will help you write that so you can tell the staff. Could you read the entry aloud once to check it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先週一度気になり、その後はいったん気にならなくなり、今朝また気づきました。先週の曜日は不確かです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 先週一度で間に気にならない期間があり今朝また気づき曜日は不確かと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: It bothered me once last week, then stopped bothering me for a while, and I noticed it again this morning. The day last week is uncertain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain it happened once last week, with a symptom-free interval before this morning, and the weekday is uncertain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 経過の説明をそのように引き継ぎます。それでは、用紙を受付へお渡しになり、担当の案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass on that description of the course. Please hand the form to reception and wait for the staff's guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: メッセージについての相談と伺いました。誰から届いたように表示されていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I heard you want advice about a message. Who did it appear to be from?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人の名前で、立て替えた代金を払ってほしいと届きました。支払いのリンクもありましたが、開いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人名の立替代金依頼とリンクが届いたが開いていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It came under my friend's name, asking me to pay money they had advanced. There was a payment link too, but I have not opened it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say a repayment request under your friend's name came with a link, but you did not open it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示された名前以外に、友人からの連絡だと確かめたことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Besides the displayed name, have you checked anything confirming it is from your friend?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 普段使う電話で友人へ聞きました。友人はそんな依頼をしていないと言っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 普段の電話で友人に聞き依頼していないと返答されたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I called my friend on our usual number. They said they had made no such request.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you asked your friend on the usual phone number and they denied requesting payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別の連絡方法で確認した結果ですね。メッセージの本文と送信元の表示は、まだ見られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: So that is the result of checking through another contact method. Can you still see the message text and sender display?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本文と表示は残っています。ただ、名前は同じでも、送信元の文字列は普段と違いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本文は残り名前は同じだが送信元文字列が通常と違うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The text and display are still there. But although the name is the same, the sender's character string differs from usual.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the text remains and the name is the same but the sender string differs from usual. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その違いも相談担当に説明できます。相手へ返信したり、リンク先に情報を入れたりはしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can explain that difference to the adviser too. Have you replied or entered information on the linked page?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 返信も入力もしていません。届いた画面と友人へ確認した時刻を、一緒に伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返信も入力もしておらず画面と本人へ確認した時刻を伝えたいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have neither replied nor entered anything. I want to show the screen and tell them when I checked with my friend too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you neither replied nor entered information and want to report the screen and time of checking with your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受信した内容と、確認できたことを分けて整理しましょう。この練習では、記録の見せ方を担当者に確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us organize received content separately from confirmed facts. In this exercise, we check with the adviser how to show the records.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 元の画面を残し、リンクは開いていないことと、友人が依頼を否定したことを別々に説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 画面を残し未開封リンクと友人の否定を別情報として説明すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the original screen and explain separately that I have not opened the link and that my friend denied the request.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will preserve the screen and explain the unopened link and your friend's denial as separate facts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、相談担当へその内容をつなぎます。画面を残したままお待ちください。続きは担当者からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass that information to the adviser. Please wait with the screen preserved. The adviser will guide you through the rest.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 箱を再利用されているのですね。上にある二つの宛先は、どちらが今回の送り先でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are reusing a box. Which of the two addresses on top is the destination for this shipment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手書きの方が今回です。印刷された方は前の荷物の送り状で、そのまま残してしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手書きが今回で印刷は以前の送り状を残した物と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The handwritten one is for this time. The printed one is the previous parcel's label, which I left on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the handwritten address is current and the printed one is a leftover previous label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二つを取り違えないよう、今回使わない表示を外す準備をしましょう。中身は前と同じ物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us prepare to remove the unused label so they are not confused. Are the contents the same as before?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今回は衣類です。古い送り状だけでなく、中身の名前が書かれたシールも残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今回衣類を入れ古い内容シールも残っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Clothing this time. Besides the old address label, a sticker naming the old contents is still on it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say this time it contains clothing and an old contents sticker remains too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今回の内容と違う表示についても整理したいですね。新しい宛先には、建物名や部屋番号まで書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us also sort out labels differing from this shipment's contents. Does the new address include the building name and room number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 部屋番号まで書きました。送り主の住所は箱の裏に書いたので、別の面でも読めるか見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 部屋番号まで記入し裏面の送り主住所を読めるか確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I wrote the room number too. The sender's address is on the back; could you check whether it can be read on a different face?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you included the room number and ask whether the sender's address on the back is readable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 差出人の表示の場所も確認しましょう。古い送り状と新しい文字が重なっている部分はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the sender label's position too. Is there any overlap between the old label and new writing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 少し重なっています。古い紙をはがすと新しい文字も欠けそうなので、差出人欄を書き直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 古紙と新文字が重なりはがすと欠けそうなので差出人を書き直すと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: They overlap a little. Peeling off the old paper might remove part of the new writing, so I want to rewrite the sender field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say old paper and new writing overlap and peeling might damage it, so you will rewrite the sender details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 不要な表示を整理してから、宛先と差出人を読める状態にしましょう。方法は準備後の箱で相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: After clearing unnecessary labels, make the destination and sender readable. We can discuss methods using the prepared box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は古い送り状と内容シールを整理し、差出人欄を書き直します。新しい宛先だけが明確になった箱で相談し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 古い送り状と内容表示を整理し差出人を直して新宛先が明確な箱で再訪すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I will remove the old address and contents labels and rewrite the sender field. I will consult again with a box showing only the new destination clearly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will sort old address and contents labels, rewrite the sender and return with a clear new destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、表示を整えてからまたお持ちください。次回は箱全体を見ながら送り方を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring it again after tidying the labels. Next time we will check the shipping method while looking at the whole box.
